items.title: Career Pathways in Technology Entrepreneurship (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Career Pathways in Technology Entrepreneurship (PDF 135, printed 131).

blocks.text: Technology entrepreneurship digital daur mein talaba ke liye career ke kai raaste deti hai. Log apna digital karobar bana kar aur shuru kar ke startup founder (bani) ban sakte hain. Kuch log programming, graphic design aur digital marketing jaise shobon mein freelancer ke taur par kaam kar sakte hain. App development, e-commerce management aur online consultancy (mashwara dene) ke careers bhi tezi se barh rahe hain. Technology ke barhne ke saath talaba innovator bhi ban sakte hain jo asal zindagi ke masail ke liye naye digital hal banayein.

blocks.prompt: Technology entrepreneurship mein chaar career raaste batayein.
blocks.explanation: Startup founder, freelancer (programming, graphic design, digital marketing), app developer ya e-commerce manager, online consultant, aur innovator jo asal masail ke digital hal banaye (koi chaar).

blocks.prompt: Poore section 9.4 ka jaiza: Apne ilaqe ke liye chhote digital karobar ka khayal banayein: zaroorat, gahak, platform aur aik kharcha batayein.
blocks.explanation: Maslan: waqt ki kami wale daftari mulazimeen ke liye ghar ke bane lunch box (zaroorat); gahak qareeb ke daftaron ka amla; orders WhatsApp Business page se aur tashheer Instagram par (platform); kharchon mein ajza aur motorcycle se delivery. (In chaar hisson wala koi bhi munasib mansooba durust hai.)

items: Careers: startup founder, freelancer, app development, e-commerce management, online consultancy, innovator.
